text: You read "Expansion bar far from the average ... climax-zone read." The warning I have read is extension; in my canon it is C11, no long above the upper channel wall, which I cannot measure (R5 not served). So I do not buy in front of price: my support is the force transition (two <=6 bars gave way to 10, mp 97.0 STRONG), and my entry waits for a pullback into ma_20 with elder >=7 (C10). That answers climax risk by not chasing it. I drop support if the next bar is a single-bar drop in elder, elder <=1, or a bearish CHoCH (R11).
